audit.why: Brand wins 47.14% over 210 games, so 5.5/10 EVEN is defensible but the lane is not favoured: Brand's 900/1050 poke beats a 625/600 kit before 6, and a stocked Pyromania into Summon: Tibbers beats an immobile mage after.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two problems at once. All seven full-layer rows read 'Skill' while the content layer read Brand/Brand/Brand/Brand/Annie/Brand/Brand, and the packet itself flags that chart: 'level chart contradicts data: Brand wins only 47.14% but the chart gives Brand 6/7 stages vs 1'.
audit.why: Kit-grounded: Disintegrate is 625 and Incinerate 600, so Brand's 900 Pillar and 1050 Sear own levels 1-5 outright. From 6 the stun-into-Tibbers chain is point-and-click on a champion with no dash and no escape, and Pyromania restocks off four casts — so the item phases belong to Annie, not to Brand as the old chart claimed.
audit.corrected: Full rows 0-3 -> Brand, rows 4-6 -> Annie. Content win[5] and win[6] moved Brand -> Annie with their whys rewritten (win[0..4] already correct). Full whys for rows 4-6 rewritten to match. One atomic chart group.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns contained no digit (lint), and Molten Shield was absent from the page entirely despite being the reason Brand's burst window fails.
audit.why: Molten Shield is a 10s shield that also damages anyone who strikes her with attacks or spells — a full E-Q-W rotation into a fresh shield buys her the trade. Pyromania stocks after 4 casts, and her Q is 4s and W 7s, so her cast count is a countable tell. Summon: Tibbers is 130/115/100.
audit.corrected: Real numbers and the shield interaction written into breakdown.cooldowns, dontsFull[0].d and dontsFull[2].d.
